sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?year (AVG(?methodCount) AS ?avgMethodsPerPaper) (COUNT(?paper) AS ?papers) WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?paper ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?methodLabel) AS ?methodCount) WHERE {
      ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
      ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 .
      ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year .
      ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?dataAnalysis .
      ?dataAnalysis orkgp:P1005 ?method .
      ?method rdfs:label ?methodLabel .
      FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodLabel)) != "no method")
    }
    GROUP BY ?paper ?year
  }
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?metricLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION ?evaluation .
  ?evaluation orkgp:P110006 ?metric .
  ?metric rdfs:label ?metricLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?guidelineAvailabilityLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181031 ?annotationProcess .
  ?annotationProcess orkgp:P181036 ?annotationScheme .
  ?annotationScheme orkgp:P181038 ?guidelineAvailability .
  ?guidelineAvailability rdfs:label ?guidelineAvailabilityLabel .
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(LCASE(STR(?guidelineAvailabilityLabel)), "yes"))
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?reTaskLabel ?inputGranularityLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181002 ?reTask .
  ?reTask rdfs:label ?reTaskLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?nlpTask .
  ?nlpTask orkgp:P181005 ?inputGranularity .
  ?inputGranularity rdfs:label ?inputGranularityLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?baselineTypeLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION ?evaluation .
  ?evaluation orkgp:P181051 ?baselineComparison .
  ?baselineComparison orkgp:P181052 ?baselineType .
  ?baselineType rdfs:label ?baselineTypeLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?dataFormatLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181011 ?dataset .
  ?dataset orkgp:P181022 ?dataType .
  ?dataType orkgp:P181023 ?dataFormat .
  ?dataFormat rdfs:label ?dataFormatLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?reTaskLabel ?nlpTaskTypeLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?paperCount) WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181002 ?reTask .
  ?reTask rdfs:label ?reTaskLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?nlpTask .
  ?nlpTask orkgp:P181004 ?nlpTaskType .
  ?nlpTaskType rdfs:label ?nlpTaskTypeLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?reTaskLabel ?nlpTaskTypeLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?paperCount)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?sectionLabel ?propertyLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?subject) AS ?customAnswerCount) (SAMPLE(?valueLabel) AS ?exampleCustomAnswer) WHERE {
  {
    ?paper orkgp:P31 ?subject .
    ?subject a orkgc:C121001 .
    BIND("ID Card (top level)" AS ?sectionLabel)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
    ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
    ?contribution orkgp:P181003 ?subject .
    BIND("NLP task" AS ?sectionLabel)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
    ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
    ?contribution orkgp:P181011 ?subject .
    BIND("NLP dataset" AS ?sectionLabel)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
    ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
    ?contribution orkgp:P181031 ?subject .
    BIND("Annotation process" AS ?sectionLabel)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
    ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
    ?contribution orkgp:P181046 ?subject .
    BIND("Implemented approach" AS ?sectionLabel)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
    ?contribution a orkgc:C121001 .
    ?contribution orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION ?subject .
    BIND("Evaluation" AS ?sectionLabel)
  }
  ?subject ?property ?value .
  ?property rdfs:label ?propertyLabel .
  ?value rdfs:label ?valueLabel .
  FILTER(STRLEN(STR(?valueLabel)) > 45)
}
GROUP BY ?sectionLabel ?propertyLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?customAnswerCount)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?constructLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?paperCount) WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
  ?construct rdfs:label ?constructLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?constructLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?paperCount)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?constructLabel ?measurementLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
  ?construct rdfs:label ?constructLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?constructLabel)), "impulsiv"))
  OPTIONAL {
    ?contribution orkgp:P175095 ?measurement .
    ?measurement rdfs:label ?measurementLabel
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?constructLabel) AS ?distinctConstructCount) WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C115015 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P175094 ?construct .
  ?construct rdfs:label ?constructLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
GROUP BY ?paper ?paperLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?distinctConstructCount)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?approachLabel WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?approach .
  ?approach rdfs:label ?approachLabel .
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
